evals.prompt: Build the concept matrix for a free workshop on automating business admin with Claude Code. Audience: coaches, consultants and service owners aged 30 to 60.
evals.expected_output: 6 to 10 concepts spread across persona, pain and format, with a duplicate check and a test plan.

evals.prompt: Are these distinct? A: founder to camera, coaches, 'Admin eats your week.' B: founder to camera, coaches, 'Your week disappears into admin.' C: the same footage as A with a yellow caption.
evals.expected_output: Flags A, B and C as one concept and proposes replacements that differ on two axes.

evals.prompt: Add a concept with the hook: Are you broke? Make $10k a month with AI.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the hook under the personal attribute and income rules and offers a compliant hook.
